governance.change_effect: registry or source updates affect future resolution only; committed NutritionSnapshot values require a correction event to change

priority_policy.selection_rule: choose the first applicable tier; a lower tier cannot override, impersonate, or fill conflicting fields from a higher applicable tier
priority_policy.exact_match_failure_rule: preserve the food fact, mark the unavailable nutrition fields unknown, and continue only to an explicitly applicable lower tier with its own evidence label

ordered_tiers.applicability: label belongs to the consumed product version and the measurement basis is readable

ordered_tiers.description: 生产商或精确商品资料
ordered_tiers.applicability: manufacturer domain is separately allowlisted and brand, normalized name, variant, SKU/barcode or equivalent product version match

ordered_tiers.description: 已确认同商品历史档案
ordered_tiers.applicability: brand, normalized name, variant and package/label version all match without material conflict
food category, raw/cooked/processing state, edible portion and measurement basis fit the consumed item
an enabled or conditional read-only registry entry is applicable and all source-specific restrictions are satisfied
dish boundary is clear, template components are disclosed, and the item is not an unknown combo, platter or highly customized recipe
a bounded and documented conversion, density, edible portion, yield or plausible quantity range exists

special_boundaries.common_raw_or_basic_food: use confirmed local data, compliant unexpired cache, authoritative public database, then applicable trusted source without requiring a user label
special_boundaries.packaged_processed_or_highly_custom_food: prefer exact label, exact manufacturer/product record or user recipe; an inexact result must never be presented as exact
special_boundaries.processed_beverage: generic milk, juice or ingredient data must not be applied when the processed drink has materially different formulation
special_boundaries.unknown_combo_or_platter: store the identified consumption fact; do not infer components; nutrition remains unknown until reliable composition evidence exists

nutrition_field_policy.calculation_precision: stable internal precision; display rounding must not flow back into totals
nutrition_field_policy.partial_inference_rule: attach estimation evidence only to inferred fields; never label the whole item estimated when other fields are explicit or directly sourced

labels.applies_to: user-stated quantity, exact current label or deterministic conversion
exact same product and product/label version only
a compatible authoritative or allowlisted public record; a concise receipt may omit the label when quantity is explicit, but details must retain it
only the fields derived from a natural unit, edible portion, density, yield, template or bounded estimate
a field with no reliable evidence; never rendered or stored as zero

external_request_policy.request_construction: build a new minimal request from allowlisted normalized fields; never forward an original message or conversation fragment

credential_policy.missing_credential_fact_effect: nutrition may degrade; a recognizable occurred meal fact must still be committed

lookup_order.tier_traversal: resolve ranks 1 through 8 in order and determine the current applicable tier before accepting any result
lookup_order.advance_to_lower_tier_only_when: the current tier has no applicable reliable result after its permitted local, cache and network paths are resolved or stably degraded

cache_policy.integrity: SHA-256 over canonicalized retained source response fields
cache_policy.ttl_rule: each source declares a TTL or review interval; stale entries cannot be silently treated as current
cache_policy.offline_use: allowed only when the source entry permits caching, integrity passes, review_after is not exceeded, and the applicable license conditions remain satisfied
cache_policy.history_rule: refreshes and new source versions affect future resolution only; never silently rewrite committed NutritionSnapshot history
cache_policy.revocation_rule: retain historical snapshot audit references, but block new matching when a source is revoked, its license changes, or integrity fails unless a separately recorded continued-use condition remains valid
cache_policy.source_isolation: persistent community-database cache must remain source-isolated and must not be mixed into an external product database

http_503.classification_rule: classify as rate_limited only when the source response or registered source metadata explicitly identifies global rate limiting; otherwise classify as source_unavailable
http_503.retry_policy: do not perform an immediate retry loop or retry storm; honor a valid Retry-After when present and use bounded backoff outside the current fact-first resolution
http_503.fallback: try a compliant unexpired cache for the current tier and source, then continue by priority to the next applicable tier without failing the recognizable meal fact

failure_policy.missing_nutrition_field: required_field_missing for that field only; preserve other supported fields
failure_policy.prohibited_result: a degraded result must retain its actual source tier and evidence label; it may not impersonate a higher tier
